summary: As part of the Lawrence-Allen Revitalization Plan, the Toronto Community Housing Corporation has begun their development to construct 233 units of affordable housing at municipal addresses listed in this Motion that meets Council's exemption policies for non-profit housing and is exempt from planning application fees, building fees, municipal development charges and parkland dedication requirements that would otherwise apply. In accordance with City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 743, Streets and Sidewalks, Use Of, Toronto Community Housing Corporation is not exempt from applicable Transportation Services' application and permit fees during construction (including construction access, tower crane, hoarding and covered walkway etc.). The approximate fees for 6 months is $140,000.00.
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council waive the fees found as References 1 to 42 and 120 to 124, inclusive, under Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 441, Fees and Charges, Appendix C, Schedule 2, Transportation Services as found in the Attachment to this Motion, payable under City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 743, Streets and Sidewalks, Use Of, for the Toronto Community Housing Corporation for each of the municipal addresses listed below for the duration of construction for the Toronto Community Housing Corporation phase of development at that particular municipal address: Municipal Address 1-11 Bagot Court 13-29 Bagot Court 111-121 Bagot Court 123-133 Bagot Court 1-17 Bredonhill Court 19-25 Bredonhill Court 27-37 Bredonhill Court 39-49 Bredonhill Court 51-59 Bredonhill Court 61-71 Bredonhill Court 73-87 Bredonhill Court 1-65 Cather Crescent 2-78 Cather Crescent 1 Leila Lane 41-49 Varna Drive 51-53 Varna Drive 55 Varna Drive 57-71 Varna Drive 73-83 Varna Drive 85-99 Varna Drive 101-107 Varna Drive 109-119 Varna Drive 1-11 Zachary Court 15-29 Zachary Court 31-43 Zachary Court
